_comment: Edit this file for your site. Everything instance-specific lives here; SKILL.md reads it at run time. Values below are for the fictional example brand Northwind (northwind.example).

content_bucket.label: Blog
content_bucket._note: The section your content program publishes to. A 'contains' filter also matches locale mirrors (/es/blog/, /fr/blog/, ...).

delivery._comment: Set method to 'chat' to skip Slack. recipient_id is a Slack user ID (DM) or channel ID; look it up with slack_search_users.

tool_prefixes._comment: MCP tool-name prefixes differ per install. Update after connecting the servers. Find them with ToolSearch, e.g. 'get_advanced_search_analytics' or 'slack_send_message'.

excluded: AI-visibility (Gumshoe / Semrush AI) is a monthly source, so it stays out of the weekly report.
